name: Shivaji
historical_biography: Founder of Swarajya. Coronated Chhatrapati in 1674. This scenario uses him as the player commander in an early-consolidation setting.
sources_note: Standard modern histories of the Maratha polity; exact campaign dates in this slice are simplified.

name: Afzal Khan (scenario commander)
historical_biography: Bijapur noble sent against Shivaji; killed at the Pratapgad encounter in 1659. Used here as the opposing commander abstraction for the slice. The battle itself is not fully simulated.
sources_note: The Pratapgad encounter is well attested; troop numbers and motives remain debated.
